notes.title: New Tracks and OST Launch
notes.content:
Hey, Desert Punks!

We've just published an update with four new awesome tracks to light it up the gameplay for you.

As soon as possible the OST will be available on the store too. 

Cheers!


[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30620907/7d96c547eb02028b2280589f210c38bb4602e328.png[/img]
